title: Highly recommend them. They dwlivered what they promise. And transmit the love for Barcelona

title: Great tour!
text: I had a great tour of El Born with Paulo - he is friendly and animated with great knowledge of Barcelona and Catalonia. He showed us some hidden gems of architecture, food and history - including the best croissant in Barcelona!
author: Lwesemann

title: So nice is used them thrice!
text:
I started my visit with the nighttime tour of the Barrio Gótico.  That was magical and fun.  Paulo's enthusiasm and vast knowledge made it special.  The small group size made it feel very personal.  I had such a nice time that I signed up for the Born tour the next day.  I was not disappointed.  Paulo also lead this tour with the same quality and energy.   I learned so much about the city!

author: Jaxlax

title: A magical tour with delicious stops
text: I lived in Barcelona but barely visited this part of town as it was not considered a worthwhile tourist attraction.  Times have changed and Green Tours through Paulo shows you exactly how far the city has come along.  He is the perfect guide as he is enthusiastic and attentive.  He makes the history come alive, fun and easy to understand.  Since it's not on the beaten path, one feels a little like a local getting a taste (literally) of what the city really has to offer.   The self-paid refreshment stops are a deliciously integral part of the tour.  I had so much fun, I ended up doing three of
author: Jaxlax

title: Awesome markets tour in Barcelona
text: We have been with Alessio, definitely the guide to choose in Barcelona! I strongly recommend this tour to taste the authentic flavor of the Barcelona local food without falling in touristic traps. Immersed in the history and the movement of the city we have visited the city center and the four markets. Alessio surprised us for his competence and his passion and tour us through the authentic Barcelona, ​​from hidden history pearls, to anecdotes about food! Thank you again for this awesome tour.
author: marcosO5007IM

title: Fun and educational
text: Had really great time on this tour, it was education  and also lots of fun!! Paulo made us travel in the past and see Barcelona history like in a movie, really exceptional, recommend it to all my friends going to Barcelona !!

title: Fantastic!!
text: The tour with Paulo was my favorite activity while in Barcelona! We went all around and he explained lots of things about history and current traditions, making it fun and interesting. Highly recommend!
author: elod164

title: El Born walking tour
text: A most enjoyable and informative tour with our guide Paolo inside and around El Born. With plenty of interesting and historical facts which help piece together the creation of this beautiful city. Entertaining anecdotes and true insider knowledge. Absolutely would recommend this tour. Thank you very much, Paolo
author: Jbs74

title: Fantastic Experience with Tour Guide Paulo
text: This walking tour provides a full understanding of Barcelona's El Born neighborhood, weaving through the narrow streets of Old City. After being in Barcelona a few days, and seeing all the other main sights, I wanted something more in-depth. This tour gave me a fresh perspective on the city. Tour Guide Paulo is extremely knowledgeable. He engaged us with stories of the past (from thousands of years ago!) all the way through the current Barcelona and the happenings of the city today. author: BradM2249

title: Wonderful small group tour!
text: I really enjoyed this tour with Alessio of El Born. He told us many fun facts about the history, culture, and architecture in Barcelona, and we stopped at interesting places along the way (including a few with delicious small bites). I very much liked that it was a small group tour, making it more interactive and fun.
author: lpalantone
